premises.text: Developers find AWS frustrating to operate and Heroku-like managed clouds stagnated, missing features and charging much more
premises.evidence_span: managed clouds like Heroku has stagnated under Salesforce and are missing essential features like SSDs and private networking. They're also much more expensive

premises.text: Render fits existing Git workflows and fully automates build, deploy, patching, scaling, load balancing, and alerting
premises.evidence_span: Render fits into your existing workflow. Simply push your code to Git. We automate everything from there

premises.text: Complex clusters (e.g., Mattermost with DB, object store, search, web servers, SSL, LBs) deploy in minutes via Approve, not days of AWS ops
premises.evidence_span: Installing Mattermost on Render requires minutes, but it takes days of setup and constant ongoing maintenance on AWS

premises.text: Infrastructure as code: define all Render services in one file and update by pushing to Git
premises.evidence_span: You can define all your render services in just one file. You can update your infrastructure by simply pushing this file to Git
